name: High-Value Investor Residence Permit ("Golden Visa")

requirements.blocker_text: A high-value qualifying investment, administered by ICS -- the specific minimum investment figure is NOT confirmed in this build; do not treat any numeric threshold for this route as reliable (see notes).
Ownership of qualifying property, granting a companion 5-year visa -- specific property-value threshold not confirmed in this build.

evidence_required.document: Proof of qualifying investment or property ownership

outcome.duration_length: 10-year investor residence permit; a companion 5-year permit is available to qualifying property owners

sources.title: Ethiopian News Agency (ENA, state news agency) -- ICS Deputy Director-General Gosa Demissie announces a 10-year investor residence permit plus a companion 5-year property-owner visa, reportedly launching 29 March 2026; no investment figure given in this announcement

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Ethiopia). STATUS: DRAFT -- this is a genuinely new, still-emerging program (announced for a 29 March 2026 launch, roughly six months before this build) and the ONLY confirmable facts are the 10-year/5-year duration structure, sourced to a tier-2 state news agency report of an official's public announcement -- no ICS or EIC page describing the program was found. NO INVESTMENT THRESHOLD IS ASSERTED HERE: tier-4 sources conflict sharply -- one industry-marketing site explicitly says no figure was given in the official announcement and flags a circulating '$10,000' figure as likely referring to a processing fee, not the investment threshold; a separate African business-press report claims a $10 million primary / $5 million alternate threshold with a job-creation requirement, citing an unverified 'Regulation No. 581/2025.' These cannot both be right, and neither is confirmed at tier-1 or tier-2 -- this dataset does not guess between them. Both requirement groups deliberately omit a numeric threshold rather than pick one of the conflicting figures. Top re-verification priority: find the underlying regulation text on ics.gov.et or the Federal Negarit Gazette before publishing any number for this route.
